name: agent-mitm-proxy
description: Egress proxy for proxy-client sandboxes: agent-mitm-proxy with TLS interception and an allowlist (allowlist.txt in the sandbox folder). Network alias 'proxy' on agent-proxy-net, out via agent-egress; one per machine

ref.description: agent-mitm-proxy commit (or tag) to build; the default is v1.3.0's commit. A full commit hash pins exactly what runs; a tag can be moved

credentialVault.description: 1: keep Claude Code's OAuth tokens in the proxy; clients get placeholders, so no real token is in a client sandbox (agent-mitm-proxy 1.3.0 or later)
